Description:
A package to merge, filter sort, organise and otherwise
mash together metabolite annotation tables. Metabolite
annotations can be imported from multiple sources (software)
and combined using workflow steps based on S4 class templates
derived from the `struct` package. Other modular workflow steps
such as filtering, merging, splitting, normalisation and
rest-api queries are included.

_commit.message:
Chore/vignette review (#2)

* text changes

* Fix workflow bugs from review

Using MetMashR
- Remove the "_" -> "/" dictionary rule: an underscore means chain
  positions are not established, so it should not be changed to a slash.
  Rewrite the explanation to match.
- Replace the claim about more InChIKeys after normalisation with counts
  computed in the vignette.

Standard mixtures
- Extract the adduct from LipidIon into a new LipidAdduct column, in the
  same notation as the Compound Discoverer ion column, and combine that
  column instead of the full LipidIon.
- Use an exact match ("^InChIKey$") when removing original-name results.
  filter_labels() uses grepl(), so "InChIKey" also removed the
  InChIKey_norm rows.
- Fix the final filter_venn() call: use upset_min_groups(2) with
  mode = "include". The old call excluded every item, so the plot
  was always empty.
- Replace the hard-coded counts (37, 31 and the unfinished identifier
  count) with values computed in the vignette, and replace "the majority
  were correctly annotated" with a per-assay table of standards and
  matched InChIKeys.

MTox700+
- Report the share of distinct InChIKeys found in both MTox700+ and
  PathBank (52.5%, which contradicts the old "less than half"), and the
  number of records with no key.

MMS case study
- Add a table of record counts at each stage for both variants: input
  records, names looked up, names with no InChIKey, distinct full
  InChIKeys, and groups by the first 14 characters.

* Fix prioritise_columns source for rows with no value

Rows where every column was NA got the last source tag, so they looked
as if the last column had supplied a value. The source is now NA.

* Add worked examples and result tables to vignettes

All vignettes
- Show pagination and the total row count in .DT() tables, and label the
  MMS result tables as previews.
